summary.text: Jamie Eldridge is a Democratic state senator representing the Middlesex and Worcester District, in office since 2009, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election. Ballotpedia lists him as James Eldridge.
He previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2003 to 2008 and is a former public interest lawyer.

paragraphs.text: James Eldridge was born on August 11, 1973, and earned a bachelor's degree from Johns Hopkins University in 1995 and a J.D. from Boston College Law School in 2000.

His professional experience includes working as a paralegal and litigation assistant for Hale and Dorr, as a legislative aide for state Senator Bob Durand, as campaign manager for state Senator Pam Resor, and as a public interest lawyer for Merrimack Valley Legal Services.
Eldridge represented the 37th Middlesex District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2003 to 2008 and has served in the State Senate since 2009.
In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Joint Committee on Revenue and was vice chair of the Joint Committee on Judiciary and the Joint Committee on State Administration and Regulatory Oversight.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
